name: How do I remove mold from window frames myself?

mainEntity.name: How do I remove mold from window frames myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: For small, surface mold, you can often clean it yourself using a mixture of water and mild detergent, or a diluted bleach solution (1 part bleach to 10 parts water) on non-porous surfaces. Wear gloves, eye protection, and a mask. Scrub the affected area, then dry it thoroughly to prevent regrowth. However, if the mold covers a large area, has penetrated porous materials, or keeps returning, professional mold remediation is recommended to ensure complete removal and address underlying moisture issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: For small surface mold, use a detergent or diluted bleach solution and scrub the area. For extensive or recurring mold, professional remediation is recommended.
